$comment: Reviewed-and-accepted npm advisories, consumed by scripts/audit-advisories.mjs.
This is the npm-side counterpart to deny.toml's [advisories] ignore list, and the
same discipline applies: an advisory is only silenced with a written reason and a
'expires' is REQUIRED and enforced. Once the date passes, the advisory counts
against the gate again and the report says the acceptance expired. Set it to the
date the blocker is expected to clear, not to a comfortable distance.

ignore.reason: DoS (OOM) in glob expansion. devDependency only — reaches eslint/typescript-eslint via minimatch and is never bundled into the shipped Tauri app, so it is not reachable by end users; exploiting it needs an attacker-controlled glob pattern at lint time. The only patched release (5.0.8, published 2026-07-23) is still inside the 7-day Renovate minimumReleaseAge cooldown, and the second copy (1.1.16) sits under minimatch@3 in eslint, which requires brace-expansion@^1 — forcing 5.0.8 there is a major-version override. Accepted 2026-07-26 pending the cooldown.
